task_title: typed as-of-git-unavailable refusal when git is absent
task_criteria: A missing git binary reaches the user as a typed 'spec error (as-of-git-unavailable)' refusal with exit 2 and zero traceback frames from spec check AND spec validate; both verbs agree; the code exists in docs/VERBS.md; a regression test test_spec_missing_git is gate-listed; with git present behaviour is unchanged.

items.criterion: A missing git binary reaches the user as a typed 'spec error (as-of-git-unavailable)' refusal with exit 2 and zero traceback frames from spec check AND spec validate; both verbs agree; the code exists in docs/VERBS.md; a regression test test_spec_missing_git is gate-listed; with git present behaviour is unchanged.
items.detail: Fresh empty-PATH real-CLI probes for both `spec check` and `spec validate` returned rc=2, stdout_bytes=0, traceback_frames=0, no FileNotFoundError, and byte-identical `spec error (as-of-git-unavailable): the git executable is not available; auger reads repository history and repository roots through git`; agree=true. auger.py:13482 routes `_git_toplevel` through `_spec_git_run`; auger.py:13492-13506 translates FileNotFoundError to SpecError; auger.py:12968-12971 renders the typed error and SystemExit(2). docs/VERBS.md:784-787 documents the code for validate/check/bundle (also :673). tests/gate.sh:273 lists tests/test_spec_missing_git.py; fresh `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_spec_missing_git.py -q -p no:randomly` exited 0 with `3 passed in 0.61s`. Fresh git-present probes returned check rc=0 with valid JSON and validate rc=0 `spec: 1 document(s), 2 block(s), 1 reference(s) ok`, both with empty stderr and zero frames. The exact configured full command `DUCKBRAIN_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 bash tests/gate.sh` completed with /tmp/aug170_gate.exit=0; its log reports `931 passed, 4 skipped in 998.76s (0:16:38)`, `pytest lock-attributed skips: 0`, `LIVE ARMS: ran 2; skipped 0`, and final `GATE PASS`.

items.criterion: Reachability/seam: the real `auger.py spec check` and `spec validate` CLI paths (including an explicit `--repo-root`) must route repository-root git discovery through `_spec_git_run`, and `cmd_spec` must render the resulting SpecError as the typed refusal with SystemExit(2), not a traceback.
items.detail: auger.py:13482 routes `_git_toplevel` through `_spec_git_run`; auger.py:13492-13506 translates FileNotFoundError to SpecError; auger.py:12968-12971 renders `spec error (...)` and SystemExit(2); validate/check register cmd_spec at auger.py:14501/14575. Fresh empty-PATH probes for both verbs, with and without `--repo-root .`, returned rc=2, stdout_bytes=0, traceback_frames=0 and identical typed stderr.

items.criterion: Failure-path specificity/back-compat: only a missing git executable is converted to `as-of-git-unavailable`; a present git that returns nonzero for rev-parse must still follow the existing `None`/typed repository-root refusal paths, and git-present spec behavior plus the pre-existing focused spec suites must remain green.
items.detail: auger.py:13483-13489 preserves nonzero rev-parse -> None. Fresh fake-git exit-1 probes for both verbs returned rc=2 with `invalid-spec-graph: unresolvable-repo-root`, not as-of-git-unavailable, and zero frames. Git-present probes returned check rc=0 with valid JSON and validate rc=0 `1 document(s), 2 block(s), 1 reference(s) ok`; the focused pre-existing spec suites exited 0 with `60 passed in 16.82s`.

items.criterion: Regression-test teeth: `tests/test_spec_missing_git.py` must execute the real CLI with git genuinely absent and assert the complete contract (exit 2, empty stdout, no traceback/FileNotFoundError, typed code) for both verbs, so the pre-fix raw FileNotFoundError behavior would fail it.
items.detail: tests/test_spec_missing_git.py:30-40 drives the real auger.py subprocess with PATH set to an empty temp dir; lines 43-60 assert rc=2, empty stdout, no Traceback, no FileNotFoundError and the typed code for both verbs; lines 63-70 assert agreement. Fresh pytest exited 0 with `3 passed in 0.66s`. A parent c9c01a3 control run from the repo root produced rc=1, 10 traceback frames and FileNotFoundError for both verbs, demonstrating that the pre-fix behavior violates the asserted contract.
